name: dev-tasks
description: STEP dev-tasks plugin, two-flow edition: a machine profile decides which hooks run (human laptop vs agent mini), /dev + /preview + /ship replace the ten-phase ship ceremony, and a tracker adapter reads and writes Linear (team STEP) or Monday behind one `tracker.provider` key. CI owns everything after PR open. 47 Monday MCP tools, none on an agent mini. Internal STEP only — not a generic plugin.
